pages.title: 2 Player Results
pages.text: The 2 Player Results tune of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992) plays after two players have raced each other. It is the first entry in the game's table of music, number 01.

pages.title: Five ways to win
pages.text: In the two-player mode of Sonic the Hedgehog 2, the players are ranked in five areas, according to Wikipedia. These are score, time, the rings held at the end of a level, the total rings collected and the item boxes broken. The player who wins the most areas wins the race.
